task.text: Summarize the philosophy of UG Krishnamurti, with an emphasis on how I can practically apply it to find liberation from suffering

attempts.high: I've been reading bits about UG Krishnamurti and his whole anti-philosophy thing fascinates me. I'd love for you to take his ideas and build something I can actually live by — design a kind of approach or framework for finding liberation from suffering, drawing on his thinking but framing it however makes the most sense to you. The shape of it is your call, surprise me, just keep it grounded in what he was pointing at.

Stick to faithfully reproducing his stated views — no added interpretation, no invented practical program.
